notes.title: DLC Costumes “Twinkle☆Christmas!!” & “Fluffy Lailaps” Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h2]New Arrival! DLC Costume “Sparkling☆Christmas!!”[/h2]
“Twinkle☆Christmas!!” is a cute and cozy costume, perfectly capturing the spirit of Christmas, released to celebrate the movie premiere of Yohane the Parhelion -SUNSHINE in the MIRROR- in Japan.
While its appearance is undeniably adorable, this costume reveals astonishing power when challenging the mirror world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/8a9cf4e9cf3a22fdc4b641a99f93ab41e016aa28.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/2fad322ce46073fa72c6318e0a6751695de162fc.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/02abee60fe5bbfcaf67525711e901ad65facf38b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/995bd4c22168133e76aa045045e738b5810b7805.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/7c9ff20a41152b477930ac5bd4b367e2139e72a5.png[/img]

[h3][u]◆Starter Card：One Oracle[/u][/h3]
This powerful card grants a shield, lets you draw a card, and if it’s a spell (blue) card, it boosts your attack power by +2. While luck plays a role, its effect is exceptional for a 1-cost card! Moreover, it’s included as a starting card, allowing you to challenge the Mirror World right from the beginning, making it incredibly strong!

[h3][u]◆Starter Charm：Sleepy Mari[/u][/h3]
A powerful charm that grants a constant +2 attack as long as your HP remains above 80%. Pair it with the starting card “One Oracle” to enjoy overwhelming power!

[h3]＜DLC Detail＞[/h3]
・Yohane-exclusive costume"Twinkle☆Christmas!!"



[h2]The DLC costume “Fluffy Lailaps” is also now available and highly popular!🐾[/h2]
This costume features striking perked-up ears and large paw pads. When worn, Yohane transforms into Lailaps (or does she?)!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/80011c70df8fbdda943745543f66737eb78ceffd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/2464bbff07e9415a0309d08f0bd753d73e83f7c2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/31b75969d62caba55fbdb241994d6c3d53bd1ce8.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/eade37835f7fa573ec38e1a290a747f68004b535.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/344323024b7910eee589c28bc422df13b55c3f0f.png[/img]

[h3][u]◆ Starter Card：Best Partner[/u][/h3]
The card “Playful Pounce,” added to your hand, is a 0-cost card that deals 4 damage. Its easy-to-use ability allows you to attack twice for the effective cost of just 1 energy.

[h3][u]◆ Starter Charm：Lailaps Badge[/u][/h3]
This charm deals damage to all enemies at the end of the second turn. With some careful planning, you might be able to wipe out all your foes with this attack!

[h3]＜DLC Detail＞[/h3]
・Yohane-exclusive costume"Fluffy Lailaps"


[h3]Let’s dive into the mirror world with Yohane, bringing an early taste of the Christmas spirit![/h3]

notes.title: The additional DLC Character Pack Vol.3 "Riko & Mari + Yohane" is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/b7a2227bd86783ec9583314f9e39ef62431e100c.png[/img]
The anime-style roguelite “Yohane the Parhelion - NUMAZU in the MIRAGE -" has released the final installment in its large DLC series, the Character Addition Pack Vol. 3! This third installment not only adds new scenarios playable with Riko and Mari but also includes Yohane’s exclusive “Astrologer” costume.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/fc95b383ff674d9afcea44560cece7c4764a01bd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/8e5175b433a2538083ebd99dcf78f7590599353d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/64852235ec54ad6d7f4dd507bcc308b7c5e38654.png[/img]


[h2]System Voices by Riko and Mari![/h2]
This DLC features numerous system voices from Riko and Mari, which can only be heard here. Enjoy unique lines and reactions that only playable characters can provide when navigating menus in the Fortune-Telling House, battling in the Mirror World, resting, or discovering treasure chests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/2c99d00452d3f45448bf690fb399363c0ffa8ebf.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/cbd22bcde18056179ba610b0996294efe0aa4d45.png[/img]

[h2]Character-Specific Stories & Events![/h2]
The DLC includes short stories that depict why Riko and Mari are challenging the “Hidden Numazu.” In addition to existing events, each character will trigger exclusive new events when landing on event tiles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/a6989a3a0b1b5e4bb4e979b803275c42b52ed42c.png[/img]▲ What has Riko so desperate?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/df52a5e1ac881df651665a675749e8d36e1d08f4.png[/img]▲ Who invited Mari into the mirror…?


[h2]Experience a fresh gameplay feel with new Starter charms and cards![/h2]
In the Character Addition Pack, each character tackles the Mirror World with their own unique starting cards and charms. The DLC-exclusive starting charms inspired by the “Nightwicked” for Riko and Mari, along with the “Fledgling Yohane” that accompanies Yohane’s costume, are all original designs for this DLC!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/7f714287dca6f1ef9b2f406df811df741632f5a5.png[/img]


[h3]■Character Details: Riko[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/8752629bcb07c3b5bafc2c86e08c7609cdfa0707.png[/img]
◆ [b]Starter Card: Riko-chan Beam[/b]
A 0-cost attack card that can only be used when your entire hand consists of attack cards! Try building a deck focused on attack cards to unleash beams freely.

◆ [b]Starter Charm: Nightwicked Lily ★New Charm[/b]
Nightwicked Lily resists minor debuffs! It proves useful in battles against formidable foes who rely on debuffs.

[h3]■Character Details: Mari[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/4f7153d6b88991fa04e5bc6a11fa21f14f2cbe97.png[/img]
[b]◆ Starter Card: Special Stew[/b]
This 0-cost card deals powerful damage, but the cost increases by 1 every time you take damage during battle. Use it frequently right at the start of a battle to aim for a quick victory!

[b]◆ Starter Charm: Nightwicked Mari [/b]★New Charm
Negates the first damage taken in battle. It pairs well with “Special Stew” for a lasting impact.


[h2]Yohane’s Summon Card Now Usable![/h2]
When playing as Riko or Mari, you can obtain Yohane’s exclusive summon card, “Mirage Shield,” available only in Vol. 3.

[h3]◆ Summon Card: Mirage Shield[/h3] ★New Summon Card
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/37f71dbdbc4cccdca69837664b5e464a6ff60cf5.png[/img]
Upon summoning, it increases your defense and adds HP recovery and shield at the end of each turn. If you use Lyraps cards while it’s active, your defense is further enhanced! This summon card embodies Yohane’s tenacious spirit, empowering you for long battles.


[h2]Yohane’s “Astrologer” Costume Included![/h2]
In Vol. 3, alongside the playable characters, Yohane’s exclusive “Astrologer” costume is included! The “Astrologer” costume features Yohane dressed in a mystical, astrologer-inspired outfit, reflecting her newfound interest in star divination.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/32c578ff23e9b6651132b06fb9131722def2ec0d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/6e6f9a6b8618577feca7b87271a85b8ae2393a9a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/c957cee5feac44fcc06f5e04f5b8e650ad136beb.png[/img]

[h3]Costume Details: Astrologer[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639041/a83734ea75f4270e2c2abcc7f2083c6d7ffaf317.png[/img]
[b]◆ Starting Card: Fortune Telling[/b]
A versatile card that deals damage to all enemies while allowing you to draw more cards. Building a deck with more spell cards will make it easier to trigger additional effects.

[b]◆ Starting Charm: Fledgling[/b] Yohane ★New Charm
Automatically creates a shield when ending a turn without one. It’s a reassuring charm for when your shield is thin or when you draw poorly early in the game.


[h3]Contents:[/h3]
・Playable Character Additions (Riko & Mari)
・Additional Story (Riko & Mari)
・Additional Event story (Riko & Mari)
・New Charms: “Nightwicked Lily,” “Nightwicked Mari,” “Fledgling Yohane”
・New Summon Card: “Mirage Shield”
・Yohane’s Exclusive Costume: “Astrologer”

Yohane the Parhelion is an official spin-off of the hit anime television series "Love Live! Sunshine". This February, fans can experience the story reimagined through - NUMAZU in the MIRAGE - a roguelike deckbuilding game featuring well-loved characters from the anime such as Lailaps and Hanamaru. 

While working as a fortune-teller in Numazu, Yohane stumbles upon an old mirror which sucks her into “Reverse-Numazu” , an alternate version of the real world! Here magic reigns through cards and Yohane must leverage these powers in order to save her friends as strange things begin to happen. What awaits Yohane each time she passes through the mirror? [b]・Use summon cards[/b] to call upon Yohane’s friends. They’ll come help you out in a pinch
[b]・A roguelike map[/b] that changes every time you enter the system, giving you a new experience each time and allowing for endless play!
[b]・Charms[/b] in the game give you an added advantage. Combine them with your cards to make them even more powerful!
[b]・Flex your outfit[/b] with a variety of costumes - from maid to monster mascot! Your cards and charms will also change according to your clothing
